name: Beechcraft 99 Airliner
summary: Stretched Queen Air airframe with PT6A turboprops, built as a 15-seat commuter airliner and later used heavily in air cargo.

engines: Two PT6A turboprops in long nacelles with exhaust stacks
fuselage: Long, narrow fuselage with a pointed nose and a row of small windows
Entry door at the rear left; freighters have a large cargo door
tail: Swept fin with a dorsal fillet

tellTales: Long, narrow fuselage with a row of small windows and a pointed nose
Low-wing twin turboprop with long nacelles and exhaust stacks
Plain, conventional tail with no extra fins

confusedWith.howToTell: The 1900 is bigger with a taller cabin, T-tail and fins on the rear fuselage and tail; the 99 is smaller, rounder and plainer.
The King Air 90 is shorter with a smaller cabin and fewer windows; the 99 is a long, narrow airliner with a longer row of small windows.
The Metro has a sharper shark-like nose and a slimmer fuselage; the 99 has a blunter nose and a deeper cabin.
